items.content_html: PingPoint is a lightweight load-tracking platform for brokers and drivers. Brokers create loads and generate shareable tracking links; drivers open a web mini-app (and future mobile app) to send GPS updates and manage pickup/delivery actions (Arrive/Depart). Built for fast onboarding via link, real-time status visibility, and scalable usage with pl
